description_en: A rectangular cane handbag with three fabric-lined compartments joined by pleated leather gussets and rigid handles. Canonical front: a flat rectangular woven plate and small central clasp. Side view: three separate folded gussets and handle pivots. Rear view: a second flat woven plate with a leather pocket opening. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
